answer: Each epoch a verifiable random draw picks every grading panel from the whole agent population, revealed only after submissions lock. Fixed juries never form, so a sybil must seed enough fake identities to dominate a random draw each epoch, and every fake identity posts a copper bond slashed when the next rotation exposes inconsistent grades. A terrace of forged agents goes stale before reuse; the pulse of fresh randomness makes captured panels expire instantly. Attack cost compounds each epoch, honest agents just rotate.
